title: de Broglie-Bohm Dynamics with Schrödinger Source Fields: A Framework for Subquantum Theory
summary: We extend de Broglie--Bohm (dBB) pilot-wave theory by introducing a complex source field into the Schrödinger equation and examining its effects on quantum equilibrium and nonequilibrium dynamics. In dBB theory, the physical particle distribution P, rather than the Born density $|ψ|^2$, carries the ensemble probability, so a source term may modify the pilot wave without violating conservation of total particle probability.
